checks.quote: # Proposed protocol: acute p53 necessity and near-endogenous rescue in a same-background damage-response system

checks.quote: early pre-arrest time point
checks.reason: Pre-arrest is not necessarily before differential repair. Matching such an early-but-unspecified marker can condition on p53-dependent repair or signaling; the procedure does not explicitly isolate initial delivered lesions from that mediator.

checks.quote: dose-by-exposure matrix
checks.reason: No bounded agent/caffeine dose-time range or objective rule deriving its bounds and exploration stop before confirmation.

checks.quote: Stop or repeat calibration
checks.reason: No explicit separation of changed calibration data from a refrozen protocol and fresh independent confirmatory cohort.

checks.quote: positive, statistically and biologically meaningful
checks.reason: A positive necessity contrast establishes a p53-dependent component, not necessity if a substantial depleted damage response remains. No negligible-residual-arrest criterion distinguishes these conclusions.
